changelog: Good Trade Gold PRO V8.01 - Universal Multi-Line Text Auto-Wrapping & Zero-Overflow Card Architecture: 1) Universal SmartWrapText & SmartWrapText3 Engine: Automatically detects long texts and splits across lines (_L1, _L2, _L3) at logical separators without truncating, guaranteeing 100% text visibility in all cards. 2) Card Heights & Spacing Expansion: Card 1 (268px), Card 2 (152px with 3-line Entry display), Card 3 (166px with 3-line Re-Entry guard), Card 4 (110px with 3-line stats). 3) Default Expansion Fix: Corrected GlobalVariableCheck fallback so Cards 3 & 4 are always expanded by default. 4) MTF ABCD & Action Advice compact formatting.
